What are the biggest events on Koh Samui in 2027? | Chinese New Year on Saturday 6 February, Songkran on 13–15 April (street water fights usually from 12 April), the 24th Samui Regatta on 22–29 May, Loy Krathong (probably 13 November) and New Year's Eve, plus 13 Full Moon Parties on Koh Phangan, reached from Samui by boat.
When is Songkran on Koh Samui? | The Songkran public holidays are Tuesday 13 to Thursday 15 April 2027, and Samui's street events usually start on 12 April in Chaweng, Lamai and Nathon. Chaweng Beach Road is the main water-fight street.
When is Loy Krathong in 2026 and 2027? | Tuesday 24 November 2026, the same night as the Full Moon Party. The 2027 date is probably Saturday 13 November, again with a Full Moon Party, but it will be confirmed only when the Thai Buddhist calendar for 2027 is published.
Which days can't you buy alcohol in Thailand in 2027? | The Buddhist holy-day bans are Sunday 21 February (Makha Bucha), Thursday 20 May (Visakha Bucha), Sunday 18 and Monday 19 July (Asahna Bucha and Khao Phansa; one calendar says a day later) and about Friday 15 October (Ok Phansa). Shops can't sell, but hotels and licensed bars may still serve.
When are the Half Moon Festival dates? | In 2026: beach-club day parties on 3 and 17 November, then full editions on 2–3 and 16–17 December with the Magic Forest night on 3 and 17 December. The 2027 dates had not been published by the organiser at the start of November 2026.
Is there a music festival on Koh Samui? | Not a recurring one in 2027. Zamna "On The Beach" ran once at CLUB SEEN in Chaweng on 21 February 2026, and the Samui Jazz Festival was last held in 2022. Festival-goers on Samui usually cross to Koh Phangan for the Half Moon Festival and the jungle parties.
When is the Samui Regatta? | The 24th Samui Regatta runs from Saturday 22 to Saturday 29 May 2027, based in Chaweng, with yacht racing in the bay and social evenings ashore.
Are buffalo fights held on Koh Samui? | Traditional buffalo fights have historically been held at small village arenas around New Year and Songkran, but we found no confirmed venues or dates for 2025–26. We don't list or sell them because of animal-welfare concerns.
